Task: Melting of Aluminum
Description: Simulate the melting of Aluminum by first equilibrating the system under NVT conditions, then relaxing it under NPT conditions, followed by a heating stage under NPT where the temperature is gradually increased to induce melting. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential and the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in each direction. Report the final density of the system in g/cm³.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)

Thought: The structure has been successfully converted into a LAMMPS data file. Now, I need to set up the LAMMPS input script using the specified simulation parameters. This script will include the use of the EAM potential, equilibration under NVT conditions, relaxation under NPT conditions, and heating to induce melting. Let's create the LAMMPS input script.
Action: write_file
Action Input: {"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/react/melting/brief/tasks/aluminum_melting_trial_1/aluminum_melting.in", "content": "
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p
read_data aluminum_structure.data

pair_style eam
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Al99.eam.alloy Al

thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press vol density

# NVT Equilibration
fix 1 all nvt temp 300 300 100
run 10000
unfix 1

# NPT Relaxation
fix 2 all npt temp 300 300 100 iso 0 0 1000
run 10000
unfix 2

# NPT Heating
fix 3 all npt temp 300 2000 100 iso 0 0 1000
run 20000
unfix 3

# Output final density
variable final_density equal density
print "Final Density: ${final_density} g/cm^3"
"}
